matrix: browser-wasm supported-browser lanes (BWASM-Q-002; D-004/ADR-0039 lane table)

policy.required: a required lane is BLOCKING for release gates; its last green run must be recent (same release candidate)
policy.experimental: allowed-failure lanes surface drift early; they can NEVER satisfy a release gate
policy.unverified: a browser absent from this matrix is unverified/unsupported — no implicit claims
policy.ownership: BWASM program maintains this matrix; changes to lane classifications require an owner decision (ADR amendment per D-004/ADR-0039)
policy.cadence: required lanes run on every PR and weekly (scheduled); experimental lanes run on the weekly schedule and release candidates
policy.promotion: lane classification changes require an owner decision recorded as an ADR-0039 amendment; green CI runs alone never promote a lane (owner direction 2026-09-11)
